units.summary: loadMetadata no longer returns errors from getRecord for KindRecord items. It always returns metadata, so Track records the item even when the inventory lookup fails. Any lookup error is dropped, including timeouts and connection errors, not only FORBIDDEN replies.

issues.title: Transient lookup failures now permanently track item without owner
issues.failure_scenario: The inventory server times out or resets the connection during Track. Before this PR, Track returned the error and the caller could retry. Now the item is stored in l.items/l.meta with an empty Owner, and nothing ever refreshes it. The client also caches the transient error for 5 minutes.

units.headline: Record lookup failures no longer fail loadMetadata/Track
units.reason: Error handling changed: Track now succeeds on every lookup error, changing caller-visible behavior.
focus: Whether only error replies (isErrorReply) should be swallowed, with network/timeout errors still returned
Track callers that relied on an error to retry later, since metadata is never refreshed after tracking
Items tracked with an empty Owner when the lookup fails

units.summary: New tests for the client's error and success caching with a fake clock, for isErrorReply including wrapped errors, and for loadMetadata falling back when the lookup is forbidden. Test-only code. The fake getter replaces fetchFromServer, so the reconnect logic is not exercised, but production behavior is unaffected.
